cache_dir.description: The directory where priority numbers and old runlevel configuration are stored.

root_dir.description: The root directory to use for the operation.

show_levels.description: Which runlevels to show. Concatenated digits, e.g., '345' for runlevels 3, 4, and 5.

default_cli_levels.description: The default runlevels affected by CLI commands if --level is not provided.

verbose_file.description: File path to print verbose information to. Empty string disables verbose file logging.
